title: Report Document
description:
reports/report.json — one cumulative file per repo, appended to over time.

One file rather than a new one per push: the working tree stays clean, and the document doubles as a readable project log. Entries are NEVER edited or removed once written; correcting something means adding an entry that says so.

schema_version.description: 2 = cumulative document. Version 1 was a single per-push object.

repo.description: owner/name, for readers of the file outside its repo. Optional.

entries.description: Newest first. The Action transmits entries[0]; the PDF renders the most recent few.
